environment.description: Deployed on a bare EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, Python 3.9 with Flask 2.3.x in threaded mode. The service is exposed directly via an Application Load Balancer with default settings (no managed rule groups attached). The CDN parameter in /dashboard is user-controllable. No Content-Security-Policy headers are set. The MQTT broker accepts unauthenticated connections on the internal VPC. IAM role attached has ec2:* and iot:* permissions. No request rate limiting configured.
